errors.evidence: The description states there are 27 different rules, but the bar chart displays 42 distinct bars/categories.

The list of x-axis labels contains numerous transcription errors. For example, it lists 'Ols' instead of 'O/s', 'Dn' instead of 'D/n', 'Hn/ad' instead of 'Hn/nd', 'C/v' instead of 'Cv/v', etc. It also includes 'S/np-C/vn', which does not appear in the chart.
The description of the y-axis tick marks omits the initial tick mark at 1.
The description incorrectly identifies the rule 'A/v' as having the highest usage. The tallest bar in the chart corresponds to the rule 'A/n'.
The value of the highest bar ('A/n') is approximately 400-500, not 'close to 1000'. The value for 'A/v', which the description incorrectly identified as the highest, is approximately 100.

errors.text_span: 等规则的使用次数依次递减
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the usage counts for the listed rules decrease sequentially. The bar heights do not follow a monolithic decreasing trend across the chart; they are arranged in several groups with varying trends.

errors.text_span: 其中部分规则（如ADJ/n、Hn/ad、Dain、Oind、A/v、C/v、P/v、C/vd、A/vd、V/vd、P/a、C/a、C/va、S/a、V/a、D/ad、C/vd、Hn/d、Old、S/d、ADJ/d、Jbc、Dip、N/oe、O/oe、A/n-Hn/v、A/n-Hn/a、S/np-C/vn、Hn/s-P/vt、A/v-Hnd、P/v-C/v、A/n-Hns）的使用次数均低于10次
errors.evidence: This claim is massively incorrect. Many of the rules listed in this sentence have usage counts far greater than 10. For example, 'A/v', 'Cv/v' (listed as C/v), and 'P/vt' (listed as P/v) all have values around 100. 'ADJ/n' has a value above 10.

errors.text_span: 显示了规则使用的显著差异
errors.evidence: This is a conclusion about the data, which the prompt instructs to avoid. The description should only state the visual information.
